name: Bring the End
summary: Andrew Brownell asks you to kill Amnennar the Coldbringer and bring back his skull. The request rests on that proof of Amnennar’s end.

sections.title: A Name to Answer
sections.body: Andrew Brownell has named the foe whose skull he seeks: Amnennar the Coldbringer. You are asked to bring back the skull as proof that the Coldbringer is dead.

faq.q: Who is asking for Amnennar's skull?
faq.answer: Andrew Brownell asks you to kill Amnennar the Coldbringer and return his skull.
Amnennar the Coldbringer is the foe Andrew Brownell asks you to kill.
Andrew Brownell wants Amnennar the Coldbringer killed and his skull returned.

attribution: In-game quest text: Bring the End
